set.body:
Outcome

Run one leave-one-run-out classifier through the common evidence, frame, design, plan, result, and receipt architecture while delegating predictive lifecycle policy to Alder.

Acceptance

- Fold-scoped preparation is leakage-safe.
- Exact OOF predictions map back to SampleId.
- Materialization is explicit and receipted.
- Dense and operator-backed sources agree.
- JVM and Scala.js pass.
- This gate closes only after every P4A child closes.
set.title: P4A: prove the predictive vertical slice through Alder
